method: Codex opened and visually inspected each of the 13 complete final Windows PDF page renders with view_image at 145 dpi. Incoming manuscript/reviewer images were not used as proof of inspecting this new PDF.

pages.observation: Title, author accents, original manuscript date and authorized research-edition status are readable; abstract preserves the narrow attraction scope.
Contribution table, exact native equations, parameters and host/basis formulas fit; running header and page number clear.
Slice, positive-gauge conjugate bar, compression, critical vector and slaving coefficient render correctly; no clipping.
Exact Up locator, notation table, normalization, determinant and powers in residual equations are clear.
Prestage, harmonic numerator, entire functions, gauge conjugation and divided identities have intact indices and denominators.
Tail values and derivative tails, removable lemma, onset equations and limiting root are readable.
Full limiting Jacobian including lower-left coupling, anchor and uniform contraction lemma are intact.
Uniform proof, center offset, exact partition, radii and shared-root argument are unclipped.
Certificate table, exact endpoint margin, whole-enclosure argument and connection theorem readable; corollary continues cleanly.
Full-state conjugation bars and two-step similarity formulas intact; narrow strip statement and proof legible.
Scope table separates connection and attraction; updated Section 8 review/publication wording fits; no collisions.
Historical reviewer limitations, relative evidence paths and conclusion readable; full-range attraction remains unresolved.
Updated authorship/authorization wording and all six bibliography entries readable; no blank trailing page.

render_location: External publication closeout: inspection/pages/. Temporary finalization renders are excluded from the committed paper payload.
